evalResult.overallSummary: Sprint 5 is well-executed. All criteria pass the threshold. 581 of 584 tests pass (3 failures are test isolation issues — all pass individually). README now fully documents --notify, --commit-adhd, and --commit-adhd-logs with usage examples. Biome lint is clean. SDK separation is perfect. Code quality is solid with consistent naming, no duplication, and proper error handling throughout. The only minor concern is a redundant catch block in harness.ts:219 that silently catches documenter errors, though the inner function already logs them.
